## Description
🎉 ANIMATED BIRTHDAY INVITATION · EDITABLE TEMPLATE · 5 THEMES

Send a birthday invitation your guests will love opening! They tap the link on their phone and the party starts: balloons float away, a disco ball lights up, candles are blown out, velvet curtains part or a piñata cracks open. Then their invitation appears with confetti, a live countdown and an easy RSVP.

No app, no Canva and no coding needed. Fill in a simple form in your browser, download your invitation, put it online for free, and send the link by text, WhatsApp or email.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🛠 HOW IT WORKS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Download the files after purchase and open editor.html on your computer.
2. Pick a theme and type your details. The preview updates as you type.
3. Press "Download my invitation".
4. Put it online for free with Netlify Drop or GitHub Pages (the guide shows every step).
5. Share your link by text message, WhatsApp, email or social media.

Need to change something later? Edit, download again and upload. Your link can stay the same.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
❓ GOOD TO KNOW
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
• Editing is done on a computer (Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox). Guests can open the invitation on any phone or computer.
• Every word can be changed, so it works in any language that uses the Latin alphabet.
• You can add your own photo.
• Free hosting is done through Netlify or GitHub. You need a free account with one of them.
• For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the files.
